notes.title: Devlog #3 - Baron's Residence
notes.content:
Greetings, noble rulers and determined city-builders,

I, your faithful Advisor, am delighted to report on the newest development of our thriving domain: the majestic Baron's Residence. As you know, this central structure represents not only the heart of our city but also the very essence of your rule.

The Baron's Residence is a testament to our city's growth and prosperity, evolving and expanding alongside it. This is not a simple, static building but a living entity that breathes with your city, changing and growing as your dominion does.

The wings, or extensions, of the Baron's Residence are far more than architectural embellishments. Each provides specific bonuses, invaluable aids to managing and developing our fair city. They are:
[list]
[*] Advisor's Wing
[*] Dungeon
[*] Knighthood's Wing
[*] Servants' Wing
[*] Stables
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40834893/392c91b045bce3bb796b2b76377bb2ba5fff0fa7.gif[/img]

The Baron's Residence is the epitome of your rule, and its progression stands testament to your skills as a ruler. Each wing you choose to add and develop further influences your city's future.

Always in your service,

Your Loyal Advisor
